newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ceylon Glass up 2 pct on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Ceylon Glass up 2 pct on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Ceylon Glass Co Ltd rose 2.04 percent or 50 cents to 25 rupees on turnover of 4,000 shares in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
"The share price is being pushed up by small investors who are optimistic about the market's overall growth prospects," said a broker.
Investor sentiment has improved on news that the main opposition party had ratified an agreement with the government to work together to end the ethnic war.
The company is Sri Lanka's biggest manufacturer of glass containers.
